name: nested-sizes-1
question: Does a nested m8i.2xlarge (8 vCPUs) reach the same density per host vCPU as a nested m8i.4xlarge (16 vCPUs), for Firecracker microVMs of 2 vCPUs and 2 GiB? It should, so this tests the comparison itself: a difference larger than the spread between replicas points at the tooling before the hosts.

why.m8i-4xlarge: The host cap-baseline-1 ran on, where density 8 passed and 12 failed, so it anchors the comparison; the ladder steps by one microVM between 8 and 12.
why.m8i-2xlarge: Half the vCPUs of the same family, so if density per host vCPU is a fair scale it should fail between 4 and 6, the same 0.5 to 0.75 per host vCPU.
